verdict.rationale: A recorded hands-on probe ran `npx -y skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development -a claude-code -y --copy`, a fully flag-driven, promptless install that fetched the repo and wrote a valid SKILL.md end to end, so an agent can install a skill headlessly. First-party docs add CLI install paths such as `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` and git-clone installs for Hermes. For Codex and OpenCode, community users report the agent itself fetches and follows a raw INSTALL.md. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a headless, non-interactive install flow (the verified path uses the generic `skills` installer), and a uniform agent-runnable path across harnesses, since installation differs per harness and Claude Code's documented route is the `/plugin` slash command.
